read.en: Coherent fell 6.0% on Nov 4 to $195.09, trading between $187.16 and $205.49 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($210.0), 10-day ($216.4), 30-day ($263.9) and 100-day ($300.2) averages and the rising 200-day ($296.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($243.12), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: Coherent 11月4日下跌 6.0%，收于 $195.09，盘中区间 $187.16–205.49，成交量放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$210.0）、10 日（$216.4）、30 日（$263.9）和 100 日均线（$300.2）以及上行的 200 日均线（$296.6）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图略有扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$243.12），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The close broke the $198.65–203.9 support (Nov 2 low, Oct 23 and Oct 30 lows), now resistance; the $187.16 low tested the late-December lows ($187.3–189.6). Resistance is $198.65–203.9, then $205.5–210.0 (Nov 4 high, 5-day) and $214.0–216.4 (Nov 3 high, 10-day). Support is $187.2–189.6, then $180. A close above $204 would target $210–216; below $187, $180.
